items.Title: 2027 Internal Audit Analyst Program - Summer Intern Opportunity
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
The Internal Audit summer analyst programme gives students ten weeks inside the team that independently reviews how the firm manages risk. You will join an audit team, test controls in a business area and report what you find to experienced auditors.

What you'll do

  • Plan and carry out testing of key processes and controls
  • Use data analytics tools to look for exceptions across large populations
  • Write clear findings and discuss them with business stakeholders

What we're looking for

  • Pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028

  • Strong analytical skills and a questioning mindset

  • Good written and spoken communication
items.CorporateDescriptionStr: JPMorganChase is one of the oldest financial institutions, serving millions of consumers and many of the world’s best-known companies.
items.OrganizationDescriptionStr: Our corporate functions cover areas such as finance, risk, human resources and audit.
